question: Can Intel deliver (a) a durable census without exhaustive 567MB LFS: Hard258 + WebArena-Verified v2 812 via pinned GHCR ghcr.io/servicenow/browsergym:0.14.3 and am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb (64-char hash, byte-identical manifest SHA d6527566) proving >=10 constructible families (deterministic random.Random(35725763380).sample, get_task_start_url expansion, product-subtree distinct SHA on path families 136/145/196/222 at 1280x720 CDP AX>10) and WebGym 292k 127k sites >=50 diverse eTLD+1 duplication 95% CI via threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 (2000 family bootstrap, HF_TOKEN) replacing exhaustive test.zip, plus (b) blind external baseline reproductions on SPIDER synthetic 40-task alias-OOD (30 orthogonal+10 mixed): Agentic Compilation DSM 99% TreeWalker+JSON IR $0.002-0.092, Stagehand selector+relevant-subtree SHA256 HIT/MISS >=0.8 after expanded stripping {form_key,uenc,store,session,nonce}, and browser-memory catalog deterministic replay — with trajectory-grouped bootstrap coverage/CIs, honest M_total_f10 Pareto vs SPIDER catalog/routing/WebMCP, as the unblocking deliverable for Graph/Physics/Product?
hypothesis: H_A_DURABLE_CENSUS_HARD258_V3: A byte-identical durable pin verified as manifest SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 (927596 bytes) with GHCR BrowserGym image ghcr.io/servicenow/browsergym:0.14.3 pinned digest and Docker digest sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb (64-char hex after colon) via >=2 genuine attempts per source (HF_TOKEN bearer with Authorization: Bearer, Hub API 200, GHCR pull --digests / docker load fallback, timeout >=300s) yields verifiable census: WebArena-Verified v2 812 tasks (700-812 total, families_ge3 >=30) plus Hard258 hard slice (>=200 hard tasks, documented hardness/product_page filter) and with deterministic random.Random(35725763380).sample(sorted families_ge3,10) executed TWICE with get_task_start_url __SHOPPING__ expansion and product-subtree anchoring (heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo node_count>1, distinct outerHTML SHA256 before==after identical TRUE and after mutation != TRUE on canonical path families 136/145/196/222 at 1280x720 CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree median AX>10 median DOM>=2000 proven) proves >=10 distinct product families constructible (union of Hard258 families and primary 812 families, counted as distinct families with anchoring true and SHA stability both directions TRUE), achieving full-tree multi-anchor AX_consistency mean>=0.6 bootstrap 95% percentile CI lower>0.5 (trajectory-grouped family-level B=2000) gap>=0.20 vs shuffle p<0.05 variance>0 delta_vs_truncated>=0.20 on the >=10 family set, plus WebGym 292k tasks/127k sites manifest diverse sample >=50 distinct eTLD+1 with family-level B=2000 duplication prevalence CI non-degenerate width>0 and threshold sweep at 0.818 and 0.9479 range>=0.05 monotonic replacing exhaustive 567MB LFS test.zip. H_B_SOTA_CEILING_HONEST_PARETO_V3: On SPIDER deterministic synthetic 40-task alias-OOD (research/intel/synthetic_alias_ood_40.json seed 360360, generator sha 5311a581, 10 header-param +10 body-param +10 auth-param orthogonal +10 mixed header+body+auth triple-channel, per-task channel label orthogonality verified no cross-channel leakage) blind reproduction per published recipe of B-AGENTIC-DSM (DSM 99% TreeWalker + deterministic JSON IR + HITL patch $0.002-0.092 per task, 80-94% compile ceiling), B-STAGEHAND (Stagehand selector + relevant-subtree SHA256 HIT/MISS with expanded stripping {form_key,uenc,store,session,nonce} achieving >=0.8 coverage after stripping vs <0.4 before on same tasks) and B-BMEM-CATALOG (browser-memory catalog deterministic replay, expected 0.0 collapse on alias-OOD) plus SPIDER internal baselines B-SPIDER-ALIAS/B-ROUTING/B-WEBMCP, all executed blind without tuning to 40-task split labels with per-task logs, yields interior non-degenerate trajectory-grouped bootstrap CIs for coverage (width>0, variance>0 when not structurally degenerate) and honest per-trajectory-reset sum-counter M_total_f10/f100 Pareto (DSM F10 ~22.6 USD $0.035/task vs ALIAS F10 ~30.1 vs WebMCP amortized F10 2.9/F100 0.725) distinguishing DSM structured collapse on mixed/auth (0.3) vs single-channel (1.0/0.9) and Stagehand stripping lift >=0.4, with |rho_shuffled|<0.20 and HITL drop>=0.30 distinguishing real compilation from nulls.
falsifier: H_A falsified if after >=2 genuine attempts per durable source (HF for WebArena 812 + Hard258 + WebGym 292k, GHCR for BrowserGym 0.14.3, Docker Hub for webarena-verified-shopping, each timeout>=300s, docker pull --digests or docker load/ghcr mirror fallback, HF_TOKEN true/false logged, Hub/GHCR digest 200 verification) no byte-identical manifest with SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 and 64-char digest sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb is produced with pinned census artifacts (primary 700-812, Hard258 >=200, families_ge3 >=30), OR deterministic random.Random(35725763380).sample(sorted families_ge3,10)x2 with get_task_start_url __SHOPPING__ expansion + product-subtree anchoring (heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo node_count>1 distinct SHA256) fails to demonstrate >=10 distinct product families with SHA stability both directions TRUE and CDP 1280x720 median AX>10 & median DOM>=2000 proven on canonical families 136/145/196/222 on BOTH primary 812 census and Hard258 superset union (if union also <10, bounded FALSIFIED to 4 families per prior audit remains), OR full-tree multi-anchor AX_consistency mean<0.6 or bootstrap 95% CI lower<=0.5 or trajectory-grouped shuffle p>=0.05 or gap<0.20 or variance==0 or delta_vs_truncated<0.20 (degenerate homepage-only [:20] truncation or incomplete stripping CI[0.7,1.0] p=1.0 rejected), OR WebGym 292k diverse sample <50 distinct eTLD+1 or family-level bootstrap B=2000 duplication CI not computed non-degenerate or threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 range<0.05/missing when HF_TOKEN succeeds (then not replacing 567MB LFS). H_B falsified if external baselines cannot be executed blind on 40 alias-OOD with per-task logs producing trajectory-grouped CIs for coverage and honest M_total_f10/f100 (when variance>0 width>0; degenerate [0,0] BMEM and [1,1] ROUTING/WebMCP flagged not counted as valid width), OR DSM and Stagehand are indistinguishable from null controls (coverage within null permutation 95% CI, |rho_shuffled|>=0.20, HITL drop<0.30, Stagehand stripping lift <0.20, delta_vs_truncated<0.20), OR Stagehand HIT/MISS after expanded stripping <0.8 and not significantly above pre-stripping, OR DSM does not show structured per-channel collapse (mixed 0.3 vs single-channel 0.9-1.0) distinguishing it from flat ALIAS p>0.05, OR honest M_total Pareto not measurable (proxy n*3200/f*6.0 detected). Single-module falsification yields overall MIXED; both fail yields FALSIFIED; both pass yields SURVIVES.

(PC-B) Toy single-header param task where Agentic DSM minimal example compiles deterministically to JSON IR and achieves coverage 1.0 blind, and Stagehand minimal selector+subtree achieves HIT 1.0 after expanded stripping. Single-attempt success is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. HF_TOKEN present true/false logged. GHCR and Docker Hub API digest 200 verification required. Evidence paths: artifacts/raw/webarena_verified_pin.json (reuse 35725763380 hash if still valid with +2 fresh GHCR/Hub API 200 retries), artifacts/raw/hf_manifest_attempts.json, artifacts/raw/hf_webgym_manifest_attempts.json, artifacts/raw/ghcr_browsergym_attempts.json, artifacts/raw/docker_hub_api_attempts.json, artifacts/raw/hard258_census.json, provenance.json hashes.

If only one source succeeds, single sha256 pinned file + download log suffices but cross-source equality must be explicitly marked UNAVAILABLE, not assumed equal. WebGym 292k manifest SHA separately logged when HF_TOKEN succeeds. Hard258 census SHA separately pinned and histogram families_ge3 recorded. All hashes stored in freeze.json/provenance.json. Reuse of prior pinned file allowed only with +2 fresh verification attempts logged this experiment.

MV4_PRODUCT_FAMILY_CONSTRUCTIBILITY_HARD258: Deterministic constructibility test must be executed exactly as specified: sorted families_ge3 from webarena_census.json (primary 812) AND from Hard258 census (hard-filtered superset, artifacts/raw/hard258_census.json), two independent draws Random(35725763380).sample(sorted_families_ge3,10) with identical seed reset logged S1 and S2 on EACH census (primary families and Hard258 families, S1==S2 expected but both logged). Each sampled family probed via get_task_start_url expansion of __SHOPPING__ placeholder plus product-subtree anchoring requiring heading/price/add-to-cart/main/contentinfo present with node_count>1 and distinct outerHTML SHA256 (with MV3 stripping) on canonical path families 136/145/196/222 verification at 1280x720 CDP (12 captures median AX688 DOM200413). For each sampled family, at least one product_page_tasks probe must show distinct SHA and anchoring true + AX_consistency contribution to count as constructible. Overall constructible count = distinct families with anchoring true among both S1|S2 plus canonical families plus Hard258 union; gate >=10 distinct. Full-tree AX_consistency mean>=0.6 bootstrap 95% percentile CI lower>0.5 (trajectory-grouped B=2000, unit=family) gap>=0.20 vs shuffle p<0.05 variance>0 delta_vs_truncated>=0.20 must be reported on the family set that reaches >=10. Without BOTH deterministic samples executed and logged per census (sample lists, per-family anchoring json), H_A inconclusive -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that clause. If HF_TOKEN absent / 401 after 2 genuine attempts (>=300s each), diverse count null must be explicitly recorded as UNAVAILABLE with attempts logged, not assumed zero; then this MV clause alone does not trigger MEASUREMENT_INVALID but H_A partially unavailable (bounded), PC-C marked UNAVAILABLE.

MV7_HONEST_COST: All cost metrics M_total_f10 and M_total_f100 are per-trajectory-reset sum-counters (resolve + bind + verify + freshness_check + browser_steps) reset per trajectory/task, summed, then amortized at f=10 and f=100 (sum / min(f,N) verified). Prohibited proxies n*3200, f*6.0, Gaussian jitter, n*constant are MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Trajectory-grouped bootstrap B=2000 resampling unit=task/trajectory (not transition), 95% CI [lower,upper] non-degenerate width reported when variance>0; degenerate [0,0] or [1,1] variance 0 flagged per prereg 12.7 and NOT counted as valid width but not invalid gate. Negative shuffle controls use |rho_shuffled|<0.20 threshold on cost vs length correlation, trajectory-grouped. Honest USD cost also reported for DSM ($0.002-0.092 per patch, midpoint $0.047) and Stagehand ($0 inference if selector-only).

Per-task logs for all 40 tasks per baseline required (artifacts/derived/sota_blind_results.jsonl including toy + 40x7 baselines, byte-identical re-run), per-channel breakdown (header/body/auth/mixed). MV9_PROVENANCE: Every artifact path+sha256 stored in provenance.json: request/spec/prereg/freeze hashes, pip freeze hash nonempty, docker images --digests hash, ghcr_browsergym_attempts, docker_hub_api_attempts, command logs for pull/load/run, HF manifest sha256/bytes (or 401 log), WebGym manifest sha when available, Hard258 census sha, generation script hash, per-baseline result jsonl, census derived jsons (primary + Hard258), ax captures/probe logs, threshold sweep table, AX_consistency fulltree json, Stagehand stripping delta table. Missing provenance for any durability, cost, or AX_consistency path -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that module.
decision_rule: Frozen three-way rule evaluated after MEASUREMENT_INVALID check: (A) MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any MV1-MV4/MV6-MV9 mandatory gating fails: <2 genuine attempts per required durable source (GHCR BrowserGym, Docker Hub webarena-verified-shopping, HF WebArena/Hard258/WebGym), missing 64-char digest or manifest SHA d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30, pip freeze empty or version/viewport mismatch (requires 0.14.3/0.4.2/1.63.0 1280x720), fallback AX snapshot used, body regex absent, deterministic sampling not executed exactly as specified on BOTH primary and Hard258 censuses, AX_consistency not computed full-tree multi-anchor with bootstrap/trajectory-grouped, Stagehand expanded stripping not ablated, honest-cost proxy/ungrouped CI detected, or provenance missing — then no SURVIVES/FALSIFIED inference, status MEASUREMENT_INVALID. MV5 WebGym diversity clause alone defaults to UNAVAILABLE not INVALID when HF_TOKEN absent after 2 genuine attempts (marked null with attempts logged, PC-C UNAVAILABLE). (B) SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff A passes (with MV5 either PASS or documented UNAVAILABLE) AND H_A_SURVIVES: (SRC_GHCR_SUCCESS OR SRC_DOCKER_SUCCESS) with census artifacts manifest_sha256=d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 total_tasks 700-812 primary plus Hard258 >=200 families_ge3 >=30 (or union >=10) AND deterministic family constructibility >=10 distinct product families with product-subtree anchoring true and SHA stability both directions TRUE and CDP 1280x720 median AX>10 & median DOM>=2000 proven on canonical path families 136/145/196/222 AND full-tree multi-anchor AX_consistency mean>=0.6 bootstrap 95% CI lower>0.5 trajectory-grouped B=2000 gap>=0.20 vs shuffle p<0.05 variance>0 delta_vs_truncated>=0.20 on the >=10 family set AND (WebGym diverse >=50 eTLD+1 with family-level B=2000 duplication CI non-degenerate and threshold sweep 0.818-0.9479 range>=0.05 and monotonic when HF succeeds OR explicitly unavailable with 2 attempts logged) AND H_B_SURVIVES: all three external baselines B-AGENTIC-DSM/B-STAGEHAND-SELECTOR/B-BMEM-CATALOG executed blind on 40 alias-OOD with per-task logs + per-channel breakdown producing interior non-degenerate trajectory-grouped CIs where variance>0, and Stagehand HIT >=0.8 after expanded stripping with lift >=0.40 vs before, and |rho_shuffled|<0.20 and HITL drop>=0.30 and delta_vs_truncated>=0.20 real vs <0.05 shuffled, and honest M_total_f10/f100 Pareto vs SPIDER alias/routing/WebMCP quantified with trajectory-grouped bootstrap (DSM F10 ~22.6 vs ALIAS 30.1 vs WebMCP 2.9). (C) Else if A passes but not all B conditions: FALSIFIED if primary census still 4 families only and WebGym sweep fails and baselines at null level; MIXED if one module passes (e.g., census 10 families survives but WebGym UNAVAILABLE, or DSM survives but Stagehand lift fails). Audit may bound ceiling narrower than SURVIVES.
